description: Defines the class ConditionalFormatValueObject used for handling conditional formatting value objects, including properties for type, value, and cell formula, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: ConditionalFormatValueObject
classes.description: A class representing a value object used in conditional formatting rules, encapsulating type, value, and cell formula information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the value object with type, value, and optional cell formula.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the conditional formatting value object.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the value object.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the object.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the object.

methods.name: getCellFormula
methods.description: Gets the cell formula associated with the value object.

methods.name: setCellFormula
methods.description: Sets the cell formula for the value object.
